review_description: I extensively researched solar companies and obtained 12 quotes. The variance in pricing was astounding. I used this site to find quality recommendations for panels & inverters. Solar Junction answered every single question I had, even the hard ones questioning quoting differences, warranty on not just the panels but the workmanship of the installers & brands of panels + inverters.All up they beat every other comparable quote. The customer service was phenomenal. The installers were fantastic and we will see when the next electricity bill comes in, how happy I am overall.

Sales process was easy and all online.   Scheduling a date for the install was easy.  Install needed a few extra cables to accommodate the panels on the roof, some extra cost.Took the old system away, organised the paperwork for the new meter.  Very easy and was done within a day.
custom service good sorted everything, quoting competitive, turn up on time and the team were very professional would recommend this company
I am happy with the product and service i have received. It made so much difference to my house.
